herbinfo.title: Ulwazi ngemithi yokubulala ukhula
herbinfo.lead: Amarekhodi avela kudathabheyisi yemithi ye-DeepWeed. Isiqondiso kuphela — landela njalo okubhalwe emkhiqizweni.
herbinfo.dataNote: Imininingwane yemikhiqizo ivela kudathabheyisi ikhonjiswa ngesiNgisi.
res.title: Ukulawula ukumelana kwemithi yokubulala ukhula
res.lead: Imigomo evamileyo yokuqapha eyehlisa ukumelana. Ukuthola iseluleko esiqondene lesilimo lendawo yakho, khuluma lososayensi wezolimo loba umfundisi wezolimo.
res.d1: Ukusebenzisa isigaba somuthi munye isikhathi ngesikhathi kukhetha izitshalo ezimelanayo. Jikelezisa phakathi kwezigaba, lezilimo lapho kungenzeka.
res.d2: Hlanganisa imithi lokulima, ukusibekela, ukujikelezisa izilimo, inhlanyelo ehlanzekileyo lokukhulula ngezandla ukuze indlela eyodwa ingenzi umsebenzi wonke.
res.d3: Ukusebenzisa kancane loba ukufafaza ukhula olukhulileyo kuvumela abasindayo ukuthi bakhiphe inhlanyelo. Landela okubhalwe emkhiqizweni ngobungako lesigaba sokukhula.
res.d4: Hamba insimu emva kwamaviki angu-1–3 ukufafazile. Ukhula olusindileyo phakathi kolufileyo lungabonisa ukumelana, hatshi ukufafaza okungalunganga.
res.d5: Hlanza amathuluzi phakathi kwensimu lensimu, ususe ukhula olusindileyo lungakakhiphi inhlanyelo.
res.d6: Bhala okufafazwe, ngaphi lini. Amarekhodi enza kube lula ukubona ukumelana futhi asiza abeluleki ukuthi bakusize.
learn.title: Funda
learn.lead: Ukuthi i-FieldGuide isebenza kanjani lokuthi yiluphi ukhula i-model eluziyo okwamanje.
learn.f1d: Thatha loba ulayishe isithombe esicacile sikakhula.
learn.f2d: I-AI iqathanisa isithombe lezinhlobo eyaqeqeshwa ngazo.
learn.f3d: Ubona izinhlobo ezintathu eziseduze kakhulu lokuqiniseka kwazo.
learn.f5d: Sitshele uma impendulo ibilungile ukuze isistimu ithuthukiswe.
learn.resNote: Imigomo evamileyo. Ukuthola iseluleko esiqondene lesilimo lendawo yakho, khuluma lososayensi wezolimo loba umfundisi wezolimo.
history.title: Izithombe zami
history.empty: Akulazithombe ezilondoloziweyo okwamanje. Hlonza ukhula uthumele impendulo ukulondoloza.
auth.lead: Ngena ukuthumela impendulo lokulondoloza umlando. Ukuhlonza ukhula kuyasebenza ungelayo i-akhawunti.
